title: Clear and White, Crisp French Tips

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an attempt to grow closer to Tosen
Jordan, I've started looking into what's
trending these days. Today, I've made my
way to the shopping
mall.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Checking the trends, huh? But why?
Doesn't that stuff just naturally
make its
way to you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, your friends will share it,
or it shows
up on your feed. They just
keep coming,
one after another.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're taking notes? Just stop. Please. I
can't.
This is your day off, yeah? You
shouldn't spend it studying and junk.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess so... Actually, if you wanna
know the trends, I know a
super easy way
to figure that out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Guess we're switching roles. Today, I'm
gonna be your Trend Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, I'm suddenly embarking
upon Trend Training with
Tosen Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
First stop, the photo booth! Gotta take a
pic while my hair and makeup are still on
fleek. A selfie's good too, but photo
booths just
hit different, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about the pose suggestions
and all that stuff. Which one should we
do? Better just stick to the usual for
your
first time, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Here. Pose like this. Easy, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Stiff much? It's giving dead body. Come
on, vibe with me here. Think,
"I'm the
cutest in the whole world!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Got it? If your heart's not in it,
your face
will show it. Now let's try
that again. Get
into iiit!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Ah, that top is high-key cute. And
it's cropped at juuust the
right length.
Adorable as hell.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Are you for real? If I try it on, I'll just want it more. And do you see those prices? Little bougie for my allowance. No way.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Instead, I've gotta burn this fit into my
mind. Later, I'll try to find
something with
a similar vibe that I can actually afford.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like, "I won't forget you." Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ha... Would it kill you to laugh at my
jokes? Anyway, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, that top is such a serve! I've been meaning to grab something oversized! And it's so cheap. Yup, you're mine now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
I can't tell if you've got more cool or
warm undertones... Not that it matters too
much. Your glow-up is all but guaranteed
with me in charge.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Let's go with an orange eyeshadow... And
a little glitter... Now some
white eyeliner
on your waterline. Can't forget the pink
mascara to make your eyes pop!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Come on, if anything, I should be putting on more. If that's how you're gonna thank me... I'm giving you a unibrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After my impromptu makeover, we spend
the rest of the day hanging
out, and I learn
more about Jordan's world.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now that hit the spot. Frappes slap so hard... And the new flavors here are always on point.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So? How was today? This is how I always
spend my days off. You know, wandering
around, eating and goofing around on my

smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But...
I'm sure it was a real bore for you,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Low-key... you looked like you were about
to burst an artery most of today. I'm
guessing this was all totally foreign to
you,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure,
I had a hard time keeping up with all
these new experiences,
but I thought I'd
hid that well... I guess not.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. But to be honest, I was so
worried about you that I didn't
really have
as much fun either.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean... It's not like I didn't have any fun.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it's pretty clear now,
right? We're
like, total opposites.
Practically from other
planets.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We're not gonna laugh at the same stuff,
so, like, it's okay to stop
trying.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm dumb, but I'm not blind. Anyway, I appreciate the thought, so... give it a rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: We don't have to vibe outside of training. We can just practice and go home, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it was hard to keep up, but the
novelty of each experience kept
things
interesting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in the end, I learned more about
Tosen Jordan. Today was well
worth it for
that alone, so I tell her as much.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I can tell when you're lying, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Seriously... You are so weird.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Isn't all that studying super boring
though?
Wouldn't it be easier just
to kick back and
relax?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's what happened to me when I tried watching this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She pulls out a video rental shop bag and
shoves it into my hands. Looking inside, I
find a DVD of Comedy Derby, the show I
told her
about.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I didn't enjoy it. Your sense of
humor is hella sus... But
seeing you bomb
your UmaTok impression got me curious.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Do you know how long it's been since I've
rented a DVD? It took
sooo much time to
find too. Recommend something online
next time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Come on, why'd that make you smile?! Anyway, could you return that DVD for me? I'm out! Thanks for the frappe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod and wave a quick goodbye to her
before sitting back, satisfied.
Finally, it
feels like I've grown closer to Tosen
Jordan—even if only by a teensy bit.
